comments.text:
Shame on Republicans for (in yet another aspect of governance) ignoring the actual specialists in the relevant sciences in the various sports. They always oversimplify real world complexities into false two-way choices, and use that to spread hate and fear - which block rational thought! 

From a sports science/medicine point of view, the interaction between sport, level, and the differences between unchanged born male and female is already complex. In many sports at some ages and levels, the females have the advantage. In some, women excel at the elite level, in some, there is no significant difference once years of access to training is accounted for.
Add in the complexity of ages of starting puberty blockers and age of hormone replacement start and time since HRT start, and of the various unusual genetics including degrees of XY born female and XX born male and even XX/XY chimeras, there are so few in any situation that the question of team access should be leftto the particular sport's experts.
